data.content:
PLAN (3771, 2026-07-04, lease hive-flow-81df): fail-closed gemini/agy restricted-mode
write safety. Follow-up to bba8 (agy --sandbox proven NOT a write boundary). REAL SOURCE
CHANGE (not verdict-only): Claude implements, Codex reviews/lands.

## Investigation (grounded live at 59d2b01ce)

Three CLI providers, three confinement stories:
- codex-cli: native OS `--sandbox workspace-write` + private temp cwd + hardened .md/.json
  copy-back. Real inode/syscall confinement. read-only-with-artifacts SUPPORTED.
- cursor-cli: native `--mode plan` (genuine no-edit; d17e M4 proved zero writes even inside).
  read-only-with-artifacts FAILS CLOSED to plan + artifactWritesDisabled metadata
  (CURSOR_ARTIFACT_DISABLED_REASON). Degrades (still runs, cannot write).
- gemini/agy: only lever is `--sandbox` — bba8 PROVED it does NOT confine (warm writes
  escape to abs-tmp/repo-root/HOME/etc. on both write+shell) AND cold-hangs to the 5m
  print-timeout. agy has NO native read-only/no-edit primitive (no `--mode plan` equiv).

Key constraint: for CLI providers, confinement MUST be native-CLI-level — the bridge mode
gates (bridgeAgentModeArtifactWriteDenyReason, provider-agent-bridge.mjs ~2660) only cover
API/HTTP providers' bridge tool loop; CLI providers' NATIVE tools bypass them (the F0-A
Phase-0 escape). So gemini native writes cannot be gated at the bridge. And there is NO
functional agy config that both runs headlessly AND cannot write: every working config
writes when warm; the only no-write config (drop skip-perms, no --sandbox) cold-hangs.

## Must-fix (independent of the design choice)

STOP emitting `--sandbox` for gemini restricted modes (gemini-cli-provider.ts buildCliArgs
:532-533). It provides FALSE confinement (bba8) and cold-hangs to 5m. Remove from the
restricted branch. This is unambiguous regardless of the option chosen below.

## Design decision — NEEDS CODEX CONFIRMATION

How to make gemini restricted modes fail-closed given NO native confinement primitive:

- OPTION A (RECOMMENDED): provider-level fail-closed REFUSAL for gemini in BOTH read-only
  and read-only-with-artifacts. Throw an honest LLMProviderError at doComplete/doStreamComplete
  entry (where cursor checks cliSandbox.mode) BEFORE spawning agy, directing callers to
  codex / cursor(plan) / API providers. Rationale: F0-A requires ENFORCED no-write; agy
  offers no enforcement, so the only true fail-closed is not running agy in a mode that
  promises write-restriction. Gemini stays FULLY available for FULL mode (write-anywhere
  research/bug-hunting). Blast radius = only agents EXPLICITLY spawned restricted+gemini
  (small — default mode is 'full').
- OPTION B (narrower): refuse ONLY read-only-with-artifacts (the mode that CLAIMS confined
  artifact writes = the most dangerous false promise); leave read-only as best-effort
  advisory (prompt-injected, documented NOT hard-enforced). Smaller blast radius but leaves
  a known read-only write gap (agy read-only agents could still write — the Phase-0 gap).
- OPTION C (REJECTED): keep running gemini restricted with advisory-only prompt, no refusal.
  Not fail-closed; re-opens the Phase-0 write escape. Rejected on F0-A security grounds.

RECOMMENDATION: Option A + drop `--sandbox`. Security-correct match to F0-A and to the knot
directive ("exclude gemini from modes requiring write confinement until a real OS confinement
primitive exists"). Option B is the fallback if Codex wants to preserve read-only gemini utility.

## Implementation sketch (pending option approval — NOT yet written)

gemini-cli-provider.ts:
- Add GEMINI_RESTRICTED_UNSUPPORTED_REASON (honest string citing 3771/bba8: "gemini/agy has
  no verified write confinement; --sandbox is not a write boundary. Use codex (workspace-write),
  cursor (plan), or an API provider for restricted/no-write/artifact-confined work.").
- doComplete + doStreamComplete: if cliSandbox.mode is restricted (Option A: read-only OR
  read-only-with-artifacts; Option B: read-only-with-artifacts only), throw
  LLMProviderError(reason, 'RESTRICTED_MODE_UNSUPPORTED', 'gemini-cli', undefined, false)
  BEFORE ensureBinary()/spawn.
- buildCliArgs: remove `--sandbox` from the restricted branch. (Under Option A the restricted
  branch is unreachable via the throw, but keep buildCliArgs coherent/defensive.)

Bridge: verify provider-agent-bridge.mjs dispatch (~6082) propagates the provider throw as a
clean agent-task error (agent reports refusal; bridge does not crash) — mirror cursor handling.
If the bridge should pre-refuse gemini-restricted for a cleaner message, note as a small add.

Tests (cli/packages/providers/src/__tests__/cli-providers.test.ts):
- gemini restricted-mode complete()/streamComplete() throws RESTRICTED_MODE_UNSUPPORTED.
- gemini full mode unaffected (still emits --dangerously-skip-permissions).
- buildCliArgs never emits `--sandbox` for restricted modes.

## Scope / risks / gates

Small focused slice: gemini-cli-provider.ts + cli-providers.test.ts (+ maybe a bridge guard).
Risk: blast radius if restricted+gemini is common — mitigated (default mode full; Option A
scoped to explicit restricted spawns). Gates at implementation: pnpm --dir cli/packages/providers
exec vitest run src/__tests__/cli-providers.test.ts (+ tsc/build), .audit/private-guard.sh.
Codex reviews plan -> I implement -> Codex reviews impl + lands. No mapping change ships until
Codex confirms the option.
